title: Independently verify P104 contact phases and bound repeated H5 retiming (no new κ)
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

Adds one source-pinned, reproducible supporting audit of [PR #5545](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5545), plus a ceiling on repeating only its `H1+H5→H6` edit. **No new construction, κ gain, selected update or complete parent admission is claimed.**

The contact moves the subtraction/sign on registers 341/345 to a full common chart. A separately written interpreter checks all 743 normalized endpoint rows, owned returns, source-read windows and complete before/after invoices. The exact paid delta is `-18H1-18H5+18H6`, with every productive target retained.

A new dense Gaussian-dyadic interpreter verifies every column of the three actual lowered rank-1/5/6 transports and their old-route/direct-route composition: **1,048,576 complex entries per mode**, including absolute phase. It uses neither vendor state interpreter for matrix comparison. The pinned source compiler and credited literal chart/recipe descriptions are reused. [NATIVE-PROOF.md](https://github.com/Clear1nsight/integer-mult-bounds/blob/b038f9d9b5cf0ce92184da909e57a3be476fc812/research/p104-contact-independent-audit/NATIVE-PROOF.md) states the conditional positive-width tensor/substitution implication, with exterior scalar coefficients kept outside tensor powers.

Even granting all 1,926 remaining global H5 jobs legal independent replacements without added cost, the frozen-target edit family has raw ceiling **(.003106074473, .003106074474)** and cannot fund .0033. [CEILING.md](https://github.com/Clear1nsight/integer-mult-bounds/blob/b038f9d9b5cf0ce92184da909e57a3be476fc812/research/p104-contact-independent-audit/CEILING.md) gives the full model, monotonicity proof and broader rank-mass relaxation. This is not a ceiling on P104 or different paid-path changes.

The parent's other native maps, 265-axis routes, archived source generator, full precision/tape and compiler/58-outer-predicate conjunction were not independently replayed. Five framework assumptions remain; no independent human or proof-kernel acceptance is claimed.

## Task and overlap

Canonical base and direct publication parent: `32890bc5de034ab8fc93ac88ead7279a6a416d04`. Reviewed PR #5545 head: `18968423711fd902aaee1099979497d55603e1dc`; predecessor PR #5544: `e2a6cce2f9db5a2c5f9714f4b9e5292dd3a10581`. Publication: `b038f9d9b5cf0ce92184da909e57a3be476fc812`.

Task `scalar-to-moment`, priority revision 7, **changed scope / partial**: explicit user-assigned verification and edit-family ceiling, rather than the original positive construction-gain gate. That gate is not claimed met. The author [released scope and requested independent review](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/5125#discussioncomment-19169220). This publishes the checker behind our [previously local-only focused handoff](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5545#issuecomment-6396679760) and adds native full-column validation.

PR #5544/#5545 retain authorship of the construction and complete claimed endpoint. Existing shared-chart/dual-ADD packages supply the general retiming method. Our #5546 concerns a different fixed-cut helper obstruction and is not consumed. Live PR/discussion checks found no newer overlapping successor in the bounded visible coverage; hidden/unpublished coverage is incomplete, so no exclusivity claim.

The byte-preserved capsule retains source data/context, exact checkers and outputs for authentication. Frozen author code is retained with its notices; it is not claimed as new work. Runtime executes only the new audit scripts, the credited prior interval engine and pinned canonical Clifford compiler/circuit definitions. No pending Git object, network, author-side price/native evaluator or workstation path is needed.

## Validation

Python 3.12.3, standard library:

```sh
python3 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/p104-contact-independent-audit --check-only
python3 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/p104-contact-independent-audit
python3 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/p104-contact-independent-audit --check-source-history
```

Expected scientific marker: `PASS_P104_CONTACT_INDEPENDENT_AUDIT`.

- Metadata and canonical pins passed. Exact published-commit byte/source-history preflight passed for 42 files. Remote tree equals the locally checked tree; canonical main is its direct parent.
- Registered normal/optimized replay passed under the unchanged shared guard in **19.017 s / 94.82 MiB** sampled peak, within 150 s / 512 MiB. Every scientific byte matches both frozen original outputs; zero exclusions.
- A relocated read-only Git-free export with spaces in its path and empty PATH passed optimized replay in **9.468 s / 69.41 MiB**. All 42 exported files stayed unchanged.
- Native controls reject three phase-only errors invisible to signed Pauli tableaux, inverse children, wrong monomial boundaries and wrong declared ranks, plus two source-authentication faults. Contact controls reject one-sided retiming, wrong sign and an intervening source read.
- Separate on-disk canonical-source and expected-receipt corruption controls fail before scientific subprocesses. The injected source exception was never imported.
- The independent dense matrix engine is new; the interval engine and native compiler/definitions are credited reused code. Mode equality is reproducibility, not a second independent implementation. Hosted CI remains separate from these local checks.

The saved raw crossing is independently bracketed and the integer compiler grid is checked; this is not a fresh full parent funding proof. [REVIEW.md](https://github.com/Clear1nsight/integer-mult-bounds/blob/b038f9d9b5cf0ce92184da909e57a3be476fc812/research/p104-contact-independent-audit/REVIEW.md) records boundaries and original versus portable receipts.

Frozen source notices are preserved.

New focused checkers, scoped ceiling, replacement implication and publication prepared for Chris R/Clear1nsight with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance. New material Apache-2.0. No independent human or formal-kernel acceptance is claimed.

## Open next questions

See [TASK.json](https://github.com/Clear1nsight/integer-mult-bounds/blob/b038f9d9b5cf0ce92184da909e57a3be476fc812/research/p104-contact-independent-audit/TASK.json) and the seven-field [HANDOFF.md](https://github.com/Clear1nsight/integer-mult-bounds/blob/b038f9d9b5cf0ce92184da909e57a3be476fc812/research/p104-contact-independent-audit/HANDOFF.md).

1. Independently validate one missing 265-axis physical caller/funding layer with explicit source/cost coverage; full parent admission remains the blocker.
2. Nominate one broader chronological paid-path change with complete optimistic costs and one small falsifier. The broad regrouping relaxation is not a physical witness, and repeated H5 edits cannot reach .0033. Check live claims first.

The completed audit has stopped. This submission starts no further search and authorizes no merge or selected change.
